readings.Aries: Your courage is not in question. Neither is the value of strategic patience. The answer that feels too obvious is probably the actual answer.
readings.Taurus: The thing you've been protecting might not need protecting anymore. Consider letting it breathe. Saying less will move this further than saying more.
readings.Gemini: Your mind is faster than your life. This is both your gift and your primary source of boredom. What worked before will not work the same way this time.
readings.Cancer: What you call being cautious is sometimes waiting to feel safe enough to begin. You may never feel safe enough. Begin anyway. Make contact with the actual person rather than the version in your head.
readings.Leo: You are visible whether you try to be or not. Make what you're broadcasting intentional. What worked before will not work the same way this time.
readings.Virgo: There is a question about yourself that your analysis keeps circling. Land on it. The answer that feels too obvious is probably the actual answer.
readings.Libra: The thing you've been putting off deciding has already been decided by your inaction. Notice this. This situation responds well to direct engagement.
readings.Scorpio: What's beneath the anger is more interesting than the anger. Go there. The connection you almost didn't make is the one that matters.
readings.Sagittarius: Your intuition about a place or situation you haven't experienced yet is probably correct. Trust it. Something small done consistently has more effect than something large done once.
readings.Capricorn: There's a version of rest you can access without losing anything. Find it. The first instinct was right.
readings.Aquarius: There is something you've observed in others that you haven't yet observed in yourself. Look. The first instinct was right.
readings.Pisces: You've given this situation your full emotional presence for a long time. A little more and it shifts. Notice what hasn't changed, not just what has.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
